text: Castelli has been a brand of Manifattura Valcismon (MVC Group) since 2003; the group was founded in 1946 by Olindo and Irma Cremonese, and the investment fund Equinox acquired a 40% minority share in 2019.
short: Castelli is a brand of the Cremonese-founded MVC Group; Equinox holds a 40% minority.

source.name: MVC Group: History
source.quote: We were created in 1946 by Olindo and Irma Cremonese.
source.note: Same page: 2003 'Acquisition of the cycling clothing brand Castelli' by Manifattura Valcismon; 2019: 'The entrance of Equinox in the assets of Manifattura Valcismon through the acquisition of a minority share of 40%'. MVC's governance page (mvcgroup.com/en/management-and-control, opened 2026-10-03) lists Alessio Cremonese as Executive Chairman plus Alberto Olindo, Gioia and Dario Cremonese on an eight-member board.
